# Policy regression corpus

Project-owned synthetic one-page PDFs generated by `generate.py` using Python
standard library only. No user documents, network, database or third-party assets.
Deterministic provenance and SHA-256 are recorded in `manifest.json`.

Six negatives cover catalog/page/link additional actions, dictionary/array action
chains, Launch and an indirect JavaScript action. Two controls preserve simple
URI and GoTo links. E2E tests require valid qpdf input, verify checksums and exercise
every profile, response codes and job cleanup.
